title: POV: Your AI Just Learned CAD
description:
POV: your AI just learned CAD. text-to-cad is a free, open-source plugin: type one sentence and your AI agent writes the code, builds a real 3D model (STEP, STL, 3MF), checks it will print, slices it and can send it to a Bambu Lab printer. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and Grok. 19,000+ GitHub stars.

Full breakdown: {main_url}
Source: https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad
AI voice (Chatterbox), AI music. Animated in code. Not affiliated with text-to-cad or Bambu Lab.

#CAD #3DPrinting #Shorts
